```{r}
library(readr)
gii <- read_csv("W4_homework_data/HDR25_Composite_indices_complete_time_series.csv")
```
```{r}
names(gii)[grepl("gii|iso3|country", names(gii), ignore.case = TRUE)]
```
```{r}
library(dplyr)
gii_selected <- gii %>%
  select(iso3, country, gii_2010, gii_2019)
head(gii_selected)
```
```{r}
nrow(gii_selected)
sum(is.na(gii_selected$gii_2010))
sum(is.na(gii_selected$gii_2019))
```
```{r}
gii_selected <- gii_selected %>%
  mutate(gii_change = gii_2019 - gii_2010)
head(gii_selected)
```
```{r}
sum(!is.na(gii_selected$gii_change))
```

```{r}
library(sf)
world <- st_read("W4_homework_data/World_Countries_(Generalized)_2173680399808997149.geojson")
names(world)
```
```{r}
head(st_drop_geometry(world))
```
```{r}
library(countrycode)
```
```{r}
countrycode(world$ISO[1:6], "iso2c", "iso3c")
```

```{r}
world <- world %>%
  mutate(iso3 = countrycode(ISO, "iso2c", "iso3c"))
head(st_drop_geometry(world))
```
```{r}
sum(is.na(world$iso3))
```
```{r}
world_gii <- world %>%
  left_join(gii_selected, by = "iso3")
names(world_gii)
```

```{r}
nrow(world)
nrow(world_gii)
sum(!is.na(world_gii$gii_change))
```
```{r}
unmatched <- world %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  anti_join(gii_selected, by = "iso3")
unmatched %>%
  select(COUNTRY, iso3)
```
```{r}
nrow(unmatched)
```
```{r}
missing_gii <- world_gii %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(
    iso3 %in% gii_selected$iso3,
    is.na(gii_change)
  ) %>%
  select(COUNTRY, iso3, gii_2010, gii_2019)

```

```{r}
class(world_gii)
```

```{r}
library(tmap)

tmap_mode("plot")

nature_colors <- c(
  "#397B65",
  "#86AD92",
  "#E5D9BC",
  "#D99C7E",
  "#B96658"
)

tm_shape(world_gii) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "gii_change",
    fill.scale = tm_scale_intervals(
      breaks = c(-Inf, -0.10, -0.02, 0.02, 0.10, Inf),
      values = nature_colors,
      value.na = "#D9D9D9"
    ),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "GII Change",
      position = tm_pos_out("right", "center"),
      text.size = 0.65,
      title.size = 0.8,
      frame = FALSE
    ),
    col = "white",
    lwd = 0.3
  ) +
  tm_title(
    "Change in Gender Inequality Index (2010–2019)",
    size = 1
  ) +
  tm_layout(
    frame = FALSE,
    outer.margins = 0.02
  )
```

```{r}
world_gii_clean <- world_gii %>%
  select(
    COUNTRY,
    iso3,
    gii_2010,
    gii_2019,
    gii_change,
    geometry
  )
```

```{r}
st_write(
  world_gii_clean,
  "world_gii_clean.geojson",
  delete_dsn = TRUE
)
```
```{r}
world_check <- st_read("world_gii_clean.geojson")

nrow(world_check)
names(world_check)
sum(!is.na(world_check$gii_change))
```
